items.title: 8.15 Effect of catalyst on equilibrium (equilibrium par catalyst ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.15, printed page 182.

blocks.text: Catalyst woh substance hai jo khud kharch hue baghair chemical reaction ki rate barhata hai. Catalyst equilibrium ki position aur equilibrium constant nahi badalta. Yeh sirf equilibrium tak pohanchne ki speed (raftar) tez karta hai. Matlab reaction ki yield (kitna product milta hai) wahi rehti hai.

Catalyst reaction ko kam activation energy wala naya rasta deta hai. Agar x-axis par reaction coordinate aur y-axis par potential energy le kar graph banayein, to catalyst ki presence (maujoodgi) mein curve ka maximum (sab se ooncha point) neechi ho jati hai, jaise Figure 8.3 mein.

blocks.alt: Energy (y) ke muqable reaction coordinate (x). Do hump (ubhar) wale curves reactants ke level se shuru ho kar products ke neeche wale level par khatam hote hain. Ooncha curve (baghair catalyst) aur neecha curve (catalyst ke saath) dono ki peak 'activated state' hai. Arrow Ea (uncatalyzed reaction) reactants ke level se oonchi peak tak, arrow E'a (catalyzed reaction) reactants ke level se neechi peak tak, aur ΔH reactants aur products ke levels ke darmiyan.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Reversible reactions par catalyst ka asar (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Catalyst ek naya, neecha rasta deta hai: neeche wale curve ki peak kam oonchi hai, is liye E'a, Ea se chhota hai. Reactants aur products ki level wahi rehti hai, is liye ΔH nahi badalta aur equilibrium ki position bhi wahi rehti hai; sirf equilibrium jaldi aata hai. Kitab ki figure mein Ea ka arrow products ki line tak neeche chala gaya hai; activation energy reactants ki level se napi jati hai, is liye hamari drawing mein Ea ka arrow reactants ki line se peak tak hai.

blocks.prompt: Contact process mein SO₂ aur O₂ ke mixture mein V₂O₅ dalne se SO₃ bohat tez banti hai. Kya is se SO₃ ki equilibrium yield barhti hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Catalyst forward aur reverse dono reactions ki activation energy barabar kam karta hai, is liye equilibrium jaldi aata hai magar usi position par; yield aur Kp wahi rehte hain. Yield sirf temperature, pressure ya concentrations badal kar barhai ja sakti hai.

items: Catalyst dono taraf Ea kam kar ke equilibrium jaldi lata hai.
Position, equilibrium constant aur yield nahi badalte (Figure 8.3).
